newsitem.title: UK: SQUASH-MARTIN TO MEET KHAN IN FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SQUASH-MARTIN TO MEET KHAN IN FINAL.

text.p: Australia's Brett Martin battled his way into the final of the Super Series play-offs on Friday with a five-game defeat of world number four Simon Parke of England.
The 34-year-old now meets Jansher Kahn in Saturday's final after the Pakistani world champion crushed Scottish world number three Peter Nicol 9-6 9-3 9-2 in the Fleet qualifying group.

Martin's 10-8 7-9 9-3 6-9 9-1 victory in the Harrow qualifying group was the result of the day though. An accidental racket blow to Parke in the first game left the Englishman's face bleeding for several minutes. Parke seemed to recover to win the second and fourth games before Martin sealed the victory in 52 minutes.
The world number eight has scarcely survived a first round on the World Tour in recent months but won the group on countback ahead of Parke and world number two Rodney Eyles.
He may now prove to be Jansher's toughest opponent in the final. The world champion has admitted he dislikes the short American scoring system over nine points that is used for the Super Series.
Martin, on the other hand, relishes a format that rewards adventure and risk, the cornerstone of his style.
